criteria.name: Ideas
criteria.description:
0 - below 0.6 — Insufficient evidence: Has no ideas at all, or all or most ideas are off-topic.
0.6 - below 1 — Attempt made: Has few ideas but ideas are not organized. Some ideas are off-topic.
1 - below 1.6 — Meets standard: Presents relevant ideas but some may be inadequately developed or unclear, or some supporting ideas may lack focus.
1.6 - 2 — Exceeds standard: Presents a well-developed response with clear organization to the question with relevant, extended and supported ideas.

criteria.name: Pronunciation
criteria.description:
0 - below 0.6 — Insufficient evidence: Pronunciation makes it impossible to understand speech. Or speaks nothing.
0.6 - below 1 — Attempt made: Speech is a little hard to be understood due to lots of errors in pronunciation.
1 - below 1.6 — Meets standard: Speaks with a clear voice but still in L1 accent. Speech is understandable. Some errors in word pronunciation, stress and sentence intonation may be found.
1.6 - 2 — Exceeds standard: Speaks with a clear voice and near-native pronunciation, stress and intonation. L1 accent has minimal effects.

criteria.name: Grammar Range and Accuracy
criteria.description:
0 - below 0.6 — Insufficient evidence: Speaks nothing or cannot produce basic sentence forms, or produce basic sentence forms with a lot of grammar mistakes that make it hard to understand the ideas.
0.6 - below 1 — Attempt made: Uses only simple sentences with errors. Errors prevent understanding frequently.
1 - below 1.6 — Meets standard: Simple sentences are mostly accurate. Some complex sentences are used, but these are limited in range, and they often have noticeable mistakes.
1.6 - 2 — Exceeds standard: Uses a wide range of structures flexibly. The majority of sentences are error free. A few simple errors may still be present, but they have “little to no” effect on the clarity, comprehensibility, and accuracy of the sentences.

criteria.name: Vocabulary Range and Accuracy
criteria.description:
0 - below 0.6 — Insufficient evidence: Speaks nothing or only produces isolated words or memorized utterances, or uses little vocabulary related to the topic.
0.6 - below 1 — Attempt made: Manages to talk about the topic using mainly simple vocabulary. Shows difficulty choosing vocabulary to speak. There are frequent inappropriacies and errors in word choice.
1 - below 1.6 — Meets standard: Vocabulary use is sufficient to discuss topics at length. There may be some repetition and sometimes inappropriate word choices, but the overall meaning is clear.
1.6 - 2 — Exceeds standard: Uses a wide vocabulary resource readily and flexibly to convey precise meaning. Uses less common and idiomatic vocabulary skillfully, with occasional inaccuracies. Uses paraphrase effectively.

criteria.name: Fluency and coherence
criteria.description:
0 - below 0.6 — Insufficient evidence: Maintains a short speech with some simple words or sentences and lots of hesitation to think, or speaks nothing.
0.6 - below 1 — Attempt made: Speaks with noticeable effort. Pauses, word repetition, and self-correction often happen. Uses very few linking words.
1 - below 1.6 — Meets standard: Can speak for a while and shows a readiness to talk at length. Sometimes loses track due to pausing, repeating, or correcting. Uses linking words to connect ideas when speaking, but not always in the right way.
1.6 - 2 — Exceeds standard: Speaks fluently with no or occasional repetition or self-correction. Any pauses are just to plan what to say next, not to find the right words. Uses a wide range of appropriate linking words.

policy: Ghi chú triển khai (không phải nguyên văn nguồn): 5 tiêu chí x 2 điểm = 10 điểm cho toàn bộ phần thể hiện của từng sinh viên. Điểm tự động từng câu/trung bình các câu của app không tương đương điểm rubric tổng thể. Giảng viên cần nghe audio để chấm Pronunciation và khía cạnh ngập ngừng/nhịp nói của Fluency; không suy ra từ transcript. Bộ nhập chỉ tạo bản nháp chờ duyệt, chưa giao lịch thi. Các câu hỏi mở không có một đáp án nội dung duy nhất. LO và expected_concepts do người nhập biên soạn để tổ chức dữ liệu, không phải chuẩn đầu ra/đáp án chính thức của tài liệu. Difficulty MEDIUM là mặc định kỹ thuật, không quy đổi trình độ CEFR.

groups.notes: Thi cá nhân. Bản mẫu trang 2 ghi Part 1: 2–3 phút, trang 3 ghi Part 2: chuẩn bị 2 phút + trả lời tối đa 2 phút; nhập theo bản mẫu (tối đa 7 phút). Trang tổng quan ghi Part 1: 2 phút, Part 2: 2–3 phút nói; giảng viên cần thống nhất trước khi duyệt. Ảnh gốc nằm ở trang 3, phải được giảng viên trình chiếu/cung cấp khi thi.

outcome.description: Giới thiệu bản thân, trả lời về hoạt động hằng ngày bằng câu hoàn chỉnh và mô tả một bức ảnh theo câu hỏi gợi ý. (Mô tả tổng hợp từ hướng dẫn; không phải CLO chính thức.)

questions.text:
ENT001 — Part 1: Introduction
Introduce yourself. Answer all five questions asked by the examiner, using complete sentences. No preparation time.
1. Where are you from?
2. What are your favorite clothes to school?
3. What time do you eat breakfast?
4. What is your favorite leisure activity?
5. What's your typical day like?
expected_concepts: Address all five introductory questions with relevant personal answers
Use complete sentences and understandable English

questions.text:
ENT001 — Part 2: Picture description
Describe the picture shown by your examiner from ENT001_Speaking Test Guidelines and Sample.pdf, page 3. Prepare for 2 minutes, then speak for a maximum of 2 minutes. Use the following questions as guides.
1. Who are they?
2. Where are they?
3. What are they wearing?
4. What are they doing?
expected_concepts: Describe visible people, setting and activity in the supplied picture
Address the four guiding questions
Present inferred identities or conversation topics as possibilities, not facts

groups.exam_name: ENT104 — Speaking Test Sample — Getting acquainted
groups.notes: Thi cá nhân. Part 1: 5 câu trong 2 phút; Part 2: chuẩn bị 2 phút, mô tả ảnh 2–3 phút. Ảnh gốc nằm ở trang 2, phải được giảng viên trình chiếu/cung cấp khi thi.

outcome.description: Trả lời câu hỏi làm quen và mô tả người, bối cảnh, hoạt động trong ảnh, phân biệt quan sát với suy đoán. (Mô tả tổng hợp từ hướng dẫn; không phải CLO chính thức.)

source.relative_path: ENT_Speaking Test Guidelines-20261014T005640Z-1-001/ENT_Speaking Test Guidelines/ENT104_Speaking Guidelines and Sample.pdf

questions.text:
ENT104 — Part 1: Introduction
Answer all five questions asked by the examiner, using complete sentences. No preparation time.
1. Where is your hometown?
2. Who is your favorite actor?
3. What job does your father/ mother do?
4. How often do you go out with your friends?
5. When you go out with your friends, where do you usually go?
expected_concepts: Address all five introductory questions with relevant personal answers
Use complete sentences and understandable English

questions.text:
ENT104 — Part 2: Picture description
Describe the picture shown by your examiner from ENT104_Speaking Guidelines and Sample.pdf, page 2. Prepare for 2 minutes, then speak for 2–3 minutes. Use the following questions as guides.
1. How many people are there in the picture?
2. Where do you think they are?
3. Who do you think they are?
4. What do you think they are talking about?
expected_concepts: Describe visible people, setting and activity in the supplied picture
Address the four guiding questions
Present inferred identities or conversation topics as possibilities, not facts

groups.exam_name: ENT203 — Speaking Test Sample — Getting Acquainted — Role-play
groups.notes: Thi THEO CẶP, 10 phút/cặp. Part 1: chuẩn bị 2 phút, diễn cả hai tình huống và đổi vai trong 3–4 phút. Part 2: hỏi mỗi sinh viên 1–2 câu, 2 phút/người. Phát riêng thẻ A/B trang 2; ngày tháng trên thẻ là dữ liệu tình huống, không phải lịch thi. Desktop hiện có phiên thi cá nhân, chưa tự ghép cặp/tách giọng; không giao đề này như bài cá nhân tự động.

outcome.description: Hỏi và cung cấp thông tin trong hai tình huống du lịch, đổi vai với bạn thi; thảo luận về lời chào và điểm du lịch. (Mô tả tổng hợp từ hướng dẫn; không phải CLO chính thức.)

source.relative_path: ENT_Speaking Test Guidelines-20261014T005640Z-1-001/ENT_Speaking Test Guidelines/ENT203_Speaking Test Guidelines and Sample.pdf

questions.text:
ENT203 — Part 1: Role-play (paired test)
Unit 1: Getting Acquainted. Your examiner gives each student the appropriate role cards from ENT203_Speaking Test Guidelines and Sample.pdf, page 2. You have 2 minutes to prepare and 3–4 minutes to perform BOTH scenarios.
Scenario 1: Student B asks Student A about the school bus trip to Da Nang: where / trip? when / trip? what / do? when / lunch? what / take? Student A responds using their card.
Scenario 2: Switch roles. Student A asks Student B about the Hanoi City Tour: when / tour? where / meet? what / see? what / cost? how / sign up? Student B responds using their card.
expected_concepts: Perform both scenarios and switch asking/responding roles
Ask full questions using the five prompts in each scenario
Give information consistent with the role card supplied by the examiner
Maintain a conversation with the partner

questions.text:
ENT203 — Part 2: Discussion
The examiner selects 1–2 questions from the list below. Answer only the selected questions, giving relevant reasons and examples. No preparation time; 2 minutes per student in total. The five questions are alternatives, not five mandatory answers.
1. What is a common greeting in Vietnam when you meet someone for the first time?
2. Is it common to shake hands in Vietnam? When do people do this?
3. What is your favorite tourist attraction in your country? Why do you like it?
4. If you could visit any tourist attraction in the world, which one would you choose? Why?
5. Do you prefer visiting natural attractions (like mountains or beaches) or cultural attractions (like museums or historical sites)? Why?
expected_concepts: Answer the one or two questions actually selected by the examiner
Give relevant reasons and examples as requested
Do not penalize a student for questions the examiner did not select

groups.notes: Thi THEO CẶP, 10 phút/cặp. Part 1: chuẩn bị 2 phút, hội thoại 3–4 phút. Part 2: mỗi sinh viên trả lời 1–2 câu trong 2 phút, không chuẩn bị. Desktop hiện có phiên thi cá nhân, chưa tự ghép cặp/tách giọng; giảng viên phải tổ chức và nhận diện từng sinh viên.

outcome.description: Hội thoại với bạn thi về phép lịch sự, cách chào hỏi, xưng hô và ứng xử trên bàn ăn; trả lời câu hỏi thảo luận cá nhân. (Mô tả tổng hợp từ hướng dẫn; không phải CLO chính thức.)

source.relative_path: ENT_Speaking Test Guidelines-20261014T005640Z-1-001/ENT_Speaking Test Guidelines/ENT303_Speaking Test Guidelines and Sample.pdf

questions.text:
ENT303 — Part 1: Role-play (paired test)
With your partner, make a conversation about etiquette in your country.
Your conversation should include:
- The ways people greet each other
- Some conversation topics they should and should not ask
- The ways people address people formally
- Some do’s and don’ts in table manners
You have 2 minutes to prepare and 3–4 minutes to speak together.
expected_concepts: Discuss greetings
Discuss appropriate and inappropriate conversation topics
Discuss formal forms of address
Discuss table manners
Interact with the partner

questions.text:
ENT303 — Part 2: Discussion
The examiner selects 1–2 questions from the list below. Answer only the selected questions, giving relevant reasons and examples. No preparation time; 2 minutes per student in total. The five questions are alternatives, not five mandatory answers.
1. In Vietnam, what are some things people do to be polite?
2. What are some good table manners in Vietnam?
3. Do you think people should be polite? Why is being polite important?
4. Is it appropriate to hug or kiss another person in greeting? Why or why not?
5. How can having good manners help you become successful?
expected_concepts: Answer the one or two questions actually selected by the examiner
Give relevant reasons and examples as requested
Do not penalize a student for questions the examiner did not select

groups.notes: Thi cá nhân. Part 1: chuẩn bị 1 phút, độc thoại 2–3 phút. Part 2: giảng viên chọn 1–2 trong 5 câu, trả lời tổng cộng 2–3 phút. Chỉ có 1 chủ đề mẫu trong tài liệu cung cấp.

outcome.description: Trình bày một khía cạnh tính cách ít người biết và thảo luận quan điểm liên quan, kèm lý do và ví dụ. (Mô tả tổng hợp từ hướng dẫn; không phải CLO chính thức.)

questions.text:
ENT403 — Part 1: Monologue
Prepare for 1 minute, then speak for 2–3 minutes.
Describe a part of your personality that others may not know.
You should say:
- what part of your personality it is
- why others may not know this about you
- how you feel about this part of your personality
- and explain how this part of your personality affects your life.
expected_concepts: Describe a less-known aspect of your personality
Explain why others may not know it
Explain feelings about this aspect
Explain how it affects your life

questions.text:
ENT403 — Part 2: Discussion
The examiner selects 1–2 questions from the list below. Answer only the selected questions, giving relevant reasons and examples. No preparation time; 2–3 minutes in total. The five questions are alternatives, not five mandatory answers.
1. How does social media influence our behavior? Do you think it affects us in a positive or negative way? Why?
2. How does stress affect the way we behave? What are some healthy ways to manage stress?
3. Which mindset (pessimistic, realistic, or optimistic) do you think leads to greater happiness and success? Why?
4. How do you deal with criticism or failure?
5. How do you balance being realistic with staying optimistic about the future, especially when facing difficult situations?
expected_concepts: Answer the one or two questions actually selected by the examiner
Give relevant reasons and examples as requested
Do not penalize a student for questions the examiner did not select

groups.exam_name: ENT503 — Speaking Test Sample — Achieving a goal
groups.notes: Thi cá nhân. Part 1: chuẩn bị 1 phút, độc thoại 2–3 phút. Part 2: giảng viên chọn 1–2 trong 5 câu, trả lời tổng cộng 2–3 phút. Chỉ có 1 chủ đề mẫu trong tài liệu cung cấp.

outcome.description: Trình bày trải nghiệm đạt mục tiêu và thảo luận về mục tiêu, động lực, trở ngại, hỗ trợ gia đình, kèm lý do và ví dụ. (Mô tả tổng hợp từ hướng dẫn; không phải CLO chính thức.)

questions.text:
ENT503 — Part 1: Monologue
Prepare for 1 minute, then speak for 2–3 minutes.
Describe a time when you successfully achieved a goal.
You should say:
- what the goal was
- how you achieved it
- how you felt about the success
- what you learned from the experience.
expected_concepts: Identify a goal you achieved
Explain how you achieved it
Describe your feelings about the success
Explain what you learned

questions.text:
ENT503 — Part 2: Discussion
The examiner selects 1–2 questions from the list below. Answer only the selected questions, giving relevant reasons and examples. No preparation time; 2–3 minutes in total. The five questions are alternatives, not five mandatory answers.
1. How can setting specific goals help you achieve your dreams? Give two ways.
2. What are some common problems people encounter when trying to reach their goals? Give two common problems.
3. How can having a positive attitude help you stay motivated and focused? Explain and give two sample situations.
4. How can advice and support from family contribute to achieving your dreams? Explain and give two examples.
5. Should parents decide on their children’s choice of major courses? Give two reasons why they should or why they shouldn’t.
expected_concepts: Answer the one or two questions actually selected by the examiner
Give relevant reasons and examples as requested
Do not penalize a student for questions the examiner did not select
